decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial line has had its own page in both years, which suggests it is a featured, established range that fits the firm's natural skincare core.
The hyaluronic serum has stayed on the website for two years and sits close to the core offer, so keeping it costs little and fits current demand for serums.
The cleansing oil launched only in 2024 and likely took over from the discontinued cleansing milk, so the firm will give it time to build sales.
